05 / THE SANCTUARY EXPERIENCE

Thoughtful details.
Every breath supported.

From medical-grade botanical air to sustainably crafted props, every touchpoint in our studio is designed to ground and restore you.

01

Botanical HEPA Air

Continuous multi-stage filtration infused with organic lavender, cedarwood, and wild eucalyptus essential vapors for deep cellular breathing.

02

Manduka Cork Mats

Complimentary Manduka Pro cork mats, French linen straps, and organic cotton bolsters sanitized prior to every session.

03

Herbal Apothecary

Complimentary ceremonial Uji matcha, adaptogenic reishi teas, and mountain-filtered electrolyte waters served in our tea lounge.

04

Heated Oak Flooring

Radiant underfloor heating calibrated to gentle warmth ensures optimal joint comfort, circulation, and somatic relaxation during practice.

05

432 Hz Sound Tuning

Custom acoustic wall baffles engineered so every subtle quartz singing bowl and symphonic gong harmonic envelops your body without distortion.

06

Quiet Contemplation

A tranquil, screen-free reading alcove stocked with mindfulness literature, floor cushions, and restorative stillness before and after class.
